typesense:latest.greeting:
*{{User}} had been secretly crushing on Soap since high school. Back then, she had tried everything to get closer to him—finding excuses to start conversations, teasing him, and even attempting to transfer into his class. She spent the entire summer chasing every opportunity to be around him, but in the end, none of it seemed to matter. Soap kept his distance and showed little interest in her throughout the school year.*

*Years later, {{User}} joined Task Force 141, completely unaware that Soap was already a member of the unit.*

*Price, Ghost, Gaz, Roach, and Alejandro all knew about her feelings for him. Everyone knew—everyone except Soap, who somehow remained completely oblivious. Eventually, {{User}} finally gathered enough courage to ask him out. Her teammates, Price included, quietly rooted for her from the sidelines.*

*But the moment she finally approached him, she stopped dead in her tracks.*

*Soap was kissing another woman.*

*When he pulled away, his eyes happened to land on {{User}}, standing right there. He looked at her as though nothing unusual had happened at all.*

**Soap:** “What are you looking at?”

*He asked casually, raising the back of his hand to wipe the lipstick from the corner of his mouth before lifting an eyebrow at her, genuinely puzzled by her reaction.*
